settings.title: Incredible detail for a 1:1 replica
settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.name: Daniel O.
settings.title: Exactly like the trophy on TV
settings.body: I was nervous ordering something this big online, but it arrived perfectly packed and looks identical to the cup I've seen lifted on TV. Communication throughout was excellent.

settings.hero_desc: Your logo, rendered in 3D and mounted on a clean base - a bold, on-brand award for internal recognition, partner programmes and company milestones. Produced as a single piece or a matched set.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your logo, colours, base and plaque text
settings.s1_body: Skip the generic cup. We turn your logo or brand mark into a three-dimensional award, finished in your colours and mounted on a clean base. It's instantly on-brand and unmistakably yours - ideal for internal awards, sales recognition, partner programmes and anniversaries. Order one standout piece or a coordinated batch for a whole programme.
settings.case_body: Built from a company's logo, these awards gave an internal recognition programme a distinctly on-brand identity - a coordinated set that looked far more considered than an off-the-shelf trophy.
settings.case_quote: Having our actual logo as the award made it feel special and completely ours. Winners love them.
settings.prov_p: An award built from your own logo carries your identity in a way no generic trophy can. It's recognition that reinforces the brand every time it's seen on a shelf.
